I’ll add regression tests and run the full suite.

item.text: The new regressions pass for both adapters: two viewers can each submit five marks, forgetting preserves the caller’s quota and cooldown, and repeated forget requests leave other viewers unaffected. Closing a stream now drops its viewer counters; closed IDs cannot be reopened. Cooldowns still carry across stream changes until 30 seconds have elapsed.

item.text:
Fixed both bugs:

- Five marks **per viewer per stream**, with independent cooldowns and bounded storage.
- Removed the global forget hold. Forgetting erases mark content and associations while retaining only documented anti-abuse counters until expiry or stream closure.

Regression tests cover independent budgets, concurrency, repeated forgetting, cooldown bypass, veto without refunds, and forgotten marks staying private/deleted.

**All 84 tests pass.** README and AGENTS updated. No commits, live/cloud actions, secret reads, or server startup.
